resources.cpuMethod: Cumulative CPU deltas only for same PID/name at both ends of each wholly-contained sample interval; new/exited/invalid pairs omitted, potentially undercounting. PID reuse with identical name and monotonic CPU cannot be detected.
resources.memoryMethod: Sum of sampled process working sets/private bytes; working sets may double-count shared pages; private bytes are committed allocation, not physical RAM.

scope: Frozen pre-goal-correction foregrounds; subsequent animated goal correction not measured by these nine captures

decisions.art: Accept Astra symmetric hand revision after visual, exact geometry, pivot and play review
decisions.performance: No supported SVG CPU/memory reduction claim; SVG software poses materially finer; no Astra versus literal SVG performance winner

goal.evidence: 32 saved original6MHz rendered frames confirm four triangular markers moving around a stationary sphere
goal.implementation: separate private SVG marker overlay, simulation-time rotation period1.25seconds; qualitative reconstruction, exact cadence unqualified

record.scope: One reconstructed Movement board; separate engine and storage; original save compatibility omitted

activation.benchmarkVariant: Astra pre-goal overlay; final overlay not included in nine measurements
